name: Blue Moon Lament
source:
Ten years prior, a mysterious phenomenon known as the Blue Moon Lament transformed ordinary people into monster-fighting heroes powered by strange, otherworldly relics. These superpowered individuals have since been nicknamed as "lamenters". 

Recently, however, these heroes have begun vanishing into thin air. Concern has gripped the world: a concern that Vidal, more formally known as the lamenter Rainbow Light, undermines. It's a hysteria, he believes, a mass panic where none should occur. 

However, when one of his best friends vanishes into thin air, Vidal quickly finds himself forced to face the reality of these claims. The clock is ticking down...and it might just be too late to save the ones he holds dearest...

[From [url=https://luea.itch.io/blue-moon-lament]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
十年前，一种被称为“蓝月哀歌”的神秘现象将普通人变成了由奇怪的、超凡脱俗的遗物驱动的怪物战斗英雄。这些超能力者后来被昵称为“哀叹者”。

然而最近，这些英雄开始消失得无影无踪。全世界都在担忧：维达尔（更正式地称为“哀叹者彩虹之光”）破坏了这种担忧。他认为，这是一种歇斯底里，一种不应该发生的大规模恐慌。

然而，当他最好的朋友之一消失得无影无踪时，维达尔很快发现自己被迫面对这些说法的现实。时间在流逝……要拯救他最亲爱的人可能已经太晚了……

[来自[url=https://luea.itch.io/blue-moon-lament]Itch.io[/url]]
